steps.text: Bring key 3940 (sold on Fibula) and destroy field runes.
steps.source: Required equipment: Key 3940, Key 3980, Destroy Field runes. If you are faced with a locked door, you need Key 3940 to open, it can be bought on the island.

steps.text: Go down the well in Fibula.
steps.source: Head to Fibula and enter the dungeon through the well.

steps.text: Follow the path (door: key 3940) and go down.
steps.source: Follow the path shown on the map. If you are faced with a locked door, you need Key 3940 to open.
Follow the path shown on the map.

steps.text: Go east, through the level 50 gate and into the right teleporter (minotaur guards and archers).
steps.source: Upon coming down, head east and through a teleporter. You will now be facing two teleporters, go through the level 50 gate of expertise and the right one.

steps.text: Go west through the fire and energy fields (minotaur mages) and use the hole: key 3980.
steps.source: Continue west through fire, and energy fields to get Key 3980, be prepared to face 3 Minotaur Mages. Key 3980 is found by "using" on a hole to the west.

steps.text: Go back and south past the minotaurs, open the door with key 3980 and go on through the minotaur room into the dragon cave (dragons and dragon lords).
steps.source: Go back and then south, kill some Minotaurs, unlock the door with you newly found key. Continue further and now prepare to face ~16 Dragons and 4 Dragon Lords.

steps.text: The tower shield is in the skeleton under the fire field in the north-west corner (destroy field rune).
steps.source: Tower Shield is in the north-west corner of the cave, under a Fire Field, inside a skeleton.

steps.text: The warrior helmet is in the skeleton south of it, behind a rock.
steps.source: Warrior Helmet is south of the Tower Shield, in a skeleton that is hidden behind a rock.

steps.text: The dwarven ring is in the skeleton north of the exit teleporter.
steps.source: Dwarven Ring is north of the exit portal, inside a skeleton.

steps.text: The elven amulet is in the dragon corpse east of it.
steps.source: Elven Amulet is directly east of the Dwarven Ring, in a fresh-looking dragon corpse.

steps.text: The knight axe is in the dead body south-east of it. The teleporter in the south-west takes you back to the dungeon entrance.
steps.source: Knight Axe is south-east of the Elven Amulet, in a dead human body. The portal in the south-west part of the last room leads back to the dungeon entrance.
